appearance.extreme: They are patterned rather than coloured, grey and rust in hard-edged patches from scalp to wrist. In the dust you would walk past them.
appearance.obvious: Their skin is mottled in irregular grey and ochre blotches, like something weathered.
appearance.subtle: Their skin tone is uneven, patched lighter across the throat.

description: Your pigment has broken into irregular patches of grey and ochre. Out in the dust you nearly disappear. Under a streetlight you very much do not.
drawbacks: You look wrong under city light
name: Mottled Skin
